info.title: API-DocTest-List Retail Orders Returns-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Return Management API provides a streamlined interface for retrieving information on return requests for retail orders. This API allows users to query and access details about customer returns, including statuses and associated order information. It is ideal for retail businesses and customer support teams looking to manage and track returns efficiently. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and retail management systems that require integration with return processing workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of return orders.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all return orders processed in the system. Use it to view the details of each return, including status and associated order information.
